name: Project JoJo 2 [Open Beta]
desc:
Step back onto the familiar streets of Morioh as you collect items, master new abilities, and create limitless combinations in Project Jojo II; the official sequel to the original hit title. 

⭐️ Fusions ⭐️ 
Combine two Stands to create a powerful new one with enhanced abilities, passives, and unique traits. 

⭐️ Blessings & ULF ⭐️
Imbue your stand with various divine powers or become the Ultimate Lifeform to master two subspecs at once. 

⭐️ Auras⭐️
Talk to Aya & her Stand Cinderella at St. Gentlemens to obtain Auras
Auras can be combined on fused stands
Legendary Tier Auras provide unique hit and kill effects 

⭐️ General Guide ⭐️ 
Top Bar - Main Menu, Quests, Mail, Map, FPS
M - Ability Menu 
X - Stand Burst
V - Active Blessing 
Z - Stand Jump
